changelog: 🚀 Single Unified JIN APK (jin-termux-v2.1.4): Complete production release combining JIN-Termux, PRoot rootfs, 100 PC Power Tools, Real-Time Voice, and Mobile-Harness Studio.

🛠️ 100 PC Tools Hub Fixed: Category pills row enabled with smooth horizontal scrolling, completely eliminating the vertical letter-wrapping bug and large vertical void. Exactly 100 features verified across 10 categories.

🤖 Harness Studio Revamped: Replaced static provider box and squished 48dp model input with interactive Provider Selection Modal (OpenCode Zen, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Anthropic, Claude, Kimi, NVIDIA NIM, Custom) and Model Search & Preset Picker Dialog.

📦 Unlimited GB Zero-Memory File Streaming: Added StreamingFileUtils utilizing 64KB NIO chunk buffers directly to disk with downsampled image previews; uploads of any size (1GB to unlimited GB) process without OOM heap crashes.
🔑 AI Provider Credentials Manager: Secure on-device AES API key vault in Harness Studio Runtimes & Engines tab to save and test keys for all providers.
